current_state.zh: A much weaker-than-expected US September jobs report (29K vs 90K expected, unemployment 4.2%, 60K in downward revisions) cooled rate-hike expectations and shifted the Fed debate toward whether any further tightening is needed, with energy prices and services inflation now the key swing factors for Q4 rate expectations, yields and crypto valuations.
